Let me reconsider. Earlier in the game, I was able to turn gray blocks green. But now I can't. What's different?
Let me look at the history more carefully:

4. I clicked a green block → all reset to gray
5. I clicked gray blocks → they stayed gray (didn't work)
6. I clicked a purple dot → white blocks appeared at cross positions
7. I clicked white blocks → they turned gray
8. I clicked gray blocks → they stayed gray (didn't work)
So the key difference is: in step 3, clicking gray blocks turned them green. But in steps 5 and 8, clicking gray blocks didn't change them.
